# Slackin (`emedvedev-slackin-extended`)

Boost your Slack community engagement with Slackin-Extended! Our customizable platform offers real-time user tracking, effortless invites, and abuse prevention. Enhance user experience with personalized themes and simple integration options. Perfect for building and maintaining a vibrant online community!

[Service documentation](https://docs.osaas.io/osaas.wiki/Service%3A-Slackin.html) · [Source](https://github.com/emedvedev/slackin-extended)

## Example

```terraform
resource "osc_instance" "example" {
  service_id = "emedvedev-slackin-extended"
  name       = "myextended"

  parameters = {
    SlackWorkspaceId = "..."
    SlackApiToken    = "..."
    # SlackInviteUrl   = "..."
    # RecaptchaSecret  = "..."
    # RecaptchaSitekey = "..."
    # Theme            = "..."
    # CoCUrl           = "..."
  }
}
```

Commented lines are optional parameters. Values marked `"..."` need a real value. Outputs are `url`, `external_ip`, `external_port` and the raw `instance` document, see the `osc_instance` resource.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `SlackWorkspaceId` | string | yes | Configuration option for slackworkspaceid |
| `SlackApiToken` | string | yes | Configuration option for slackapitoken |
| `SlackInviteUrl` | string | no | URL endpoint for external service |
| `RecaptchaSecret` | string | no | Secret key for encryption or authentication |
| `RecaptchaSitekey` | string | no | Configuration option for recaptchasitekey |
| `Theme` | string | no | Configuration option for theme |
| `CoCUrl` | string | no | Configuration option for cocurl |

The instance `name` must match `^\w+$` and be unique per service within the workspace. OSC lowercases it and allows at most 20 characters.

Parameter values are strings; booleans take `"true"` or `"false"`. Reference an `osc_secret` as `osc_secret.<name>.ref` to keep a value out of the instance configuration. This page is generated from the OSC catalog; the provider validates against the live catalog when planning.
